description: This file implements a Kubernetes controller for managing ResourceClaims associated with ResourceClaimTemplates in pods. It handles event processing, resource claim creation, reservation, validation, and cleanup, integrating with Kubernetes API and metrics.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Main controller struct managing ResourceClaims and ResourceClaimTemplates, handling event processing, resource creation, reservation, validation, and cleanup.

classes.name: customCollector
classes.description: Metrics collector for ResourceClaims, providing metrics on resource claim counts with labels for allocation status, admin access, and source.

methods.name: NewController
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new ResourceClaim Controller with event handlers and indexers.

methods.name: enqueueResourceClaimTemplate
methods.description: Enqueues pods related to a ResourceClaimTemplate when it is added or updated.

methods.name: enqueuePod
methods.description: Enqueues a pod for processing if it has resource claims or extended resource claims.

methods.name: podNeedsClaims
methods.description: Determines if a pod needs resource claims based on its state.

methods.name: podNeedsWork
methods.description: Checks if a pod requires further processing, such as claim reservation.

methods.name: enqueueResourceClaim
methods.description: Enqueues a resource claim and related pods when it is added or updated.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the controller's worker routines and event processing.

methods.name: runWorker
methods.description: Processes work items from the queue.

methods.name: processNextWorkItem
methods.description: Fetches and processes the next item from the work queue.

methods.name: syncHandler
methods.description: Dispatches work items to specific sync functions based on key prefix.

methods.name: syncPod
methods.description: Synchronizes the state of a pod, creating or reserving resource claims as needed.

methods.name: handleClaim
methods.description: Handles creation and validation of resource claims for a pod's resource claim.

methods.name: needsAdminAccess
methods.description: Checks if a resource claim template requests admin access.

methods.name: hasPrioritizedList
methods.description: Checks if a resource claim template includes prioritized subrequests.

methods.name: findPodResourceClaim
methods.description: Finds an existing ResourceClaim associated with a pod and a specific claim.

methods.name: reserveForPod
methods.description: Reserves a resource claim for a specific pod.

methods.name: syncClaim
methods.description: Synchronizes a resource claim, validating reservations and cleaning up stale entries.

methods.name: owningPod
methods.description: Returns the owning pod's name and UID for a resource claim.

methods.name: podResourceClaimTemplateIndexFunc
methods.description: Indexes pods by their resource claim templates.

methods.name: podResourceClaimIndexFunc
methods.description: Indexes pods by their resource claims.

methods.name: isPodDone
methods.description: Determines if a pod is terminated or not scheduled.

methods.name: claimPodOwnerIndexFunc
methods.description: Indexes resource claims by owning pod UID.

methods.name: getAdminAccessMetricLabel
methods.description: Returns a label indicating if a resource claim requests admin access.
